target: forge.sh pr-create (gitlab) — FORGE_URL path prefix is stripped from an https remote path when it matches
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/gl/g/s/p.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001 FORGE_URL=https://gitlab.example.test/gl
for pid in g%2Fs%2Fp other%2Fp; do
  fx_http "GET /gl/api/v4/projects/$pid/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[]'
  fx_http "POST /gl/api/v4/projects/$pid/merge_requests" 201 '{"iid":5,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/gl/x/-/merge_requests/5"}'
done
for spec in "prefixed|https://gitlab.example.test/gl/g/s/p.git" "unprefixed|https://gitlab.example.test/other/p.git" "scp|git@gitlab.example.test:g/s/p.git"; do
  fx_setremote "${spec#*|}"; fx_reqs_clear
  fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md
  echo "${spec%%|*} $(grep '^POST ' "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/requests.log" 2>/dev/null)"
done
fx_done
